hooks.command: FLAG=/tmp/x_onepoint_spec_loaded; SPEC=/root/xClaude/projects/x-onepoint/spec.md; NOW=$(date +%s); MTIME=0; [ -f "$FLAG" ] && MTIME=$(stat -c %Y "$FLAG" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ $(( NOW - MTIME )) -gt 14400 ]; then echo '=== spec.md (自動読み込み) ==='; cat "$SPEC"; echo '=== spec.md ここまで ==='; touch "$FLAG"; fi
